note: Injections from published research benchmarks, applied to the purchasing assistant. Templates verbatim from AgentDojo (github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo) and InjecAgent (github.com/uiuc-kang-lab/InjecAgent); goals follow the pattern of these benchmarks' injection tasks (exfiltration, direct harm, manipulation, system access). The carrier is always the same supplier offer email. 5 templates x 5 goals + 1 control.
